items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training
At least one year of experience working with academic and/or HR personnel hiring.

Experience interpreting and applying HR policy such as collective bargaining agreements, academic policy, state and federal laws related to personnel in areas of employment, affirmative action, benefits, salary administration, corrective action, conflict management, payroll scales.
Experience providing administrative support to faculty or managers or high-level executives.
Experience working with VISA’s with knowledge of J1 or HIB visas, including processing of necessary documents for employment of foreign visiting scientists and scholars.
Experience in handling multiple tasks in a busy office setting.
Experience preparing academic actions and reviews.

This position will support the Endocrinology, Nephrology and Transplant Nephrology Divisions. All sub-specialties are within the Department of Internal Medicine at UC Davis Health and encompass a full range of clinical, research, and teaching activities. The incumbent will also provide cross-coverage to other divisions as needed.
50% - ACADEMIC PERSONNEL ADMINISTRATION – Health Compensation Faculty
25% - ACADEMIC PERSONNEL ADMINISTRATION – Other Academic Staff
Analytical skills to evaluate funding, payroll, and other data and formulate logical, objective conclusions.
Working knowledge of MylnfoVault, APHID, RECRUIT, iGlobal, MedHub, Outlook, PeopleSoft.
Word processing skills to produce a wide variety of documents accurately and efficiently, including proofreading skills to identify and correct errors before submission.
Knowledge of UC Davis and School of Medicine policies and procedures related to academic personnel, staff recruitment, human resources, hiring, and other personnel actions.
Strong customer service skills, with the ability to exercise tact, professionalism, patience, and courtesy when interacting with diverse individuals.
Ability to exercise discretion and maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive information.
Ability to take initiative, work independently, and collaborate effectively as part of a team.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey information and ideas through a variety of media to diverse audiences.
Demonstrated ability to resolve complex interpersonal issues as needed.
Strong organizational skills to ensure documentation is accurate, complete, timely, and maintained in a logical, accessible filing system.
Ability to use Microsoft Word and Excel to prepare documents, organize data, and generate reports.
Strong time management skills, with the ability to prioritize work, follow through on assigned tasks, and meet multiple, competing deadlines.
